policy.interpretation: Treasury replaces the 0.5 percentage points removed from the mining contribution. Exact calculation basis and on-chain implementation are pending public technical specification.
policy.donation_integrity: 100 percent of the amount explicitly declared and committed as a donation must reach the beneficiary. Costs and gross proceeds are accounted for separately.

notes: Empty lists and null balances mean no verified public records are available. They do not mean a confirmed zero balance.
